response.overview: Lee Sol sometimes dreams. It's a dream where the same friend comes out every time. Sol is always waiting for his friend, always waiting for him to dream, but as he gets busier and busier as the exam period approaches, he rarely dreams, and eventually realizes that Sol hasn't had a dream recently. However, Sol, unable to endure the situation around him, which is only getting worse, eventually decides to visit him himself.
response.title: way
